# durantic_mesh_network (Resource)

Mesh network resource for Durantic infrastructure



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the mesh network
- `network_cidr` (String) Network CIDR range (e.g., 10.0.0.0/16). Cannot be changed after creation.

### Optional

- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this is the default mesh network
- `route_reflector_mode` (Boolean) Whether route reflector mode is enabled for this network

### Read-Only

- `available_ip_count` (Number) Number of available IP addresses in the network
- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the network was created
- `machine_count` (Number) Number of machines in the network
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the network was last updated
- `uuid` (String) Unique identifier for the mesh network
